description: React component for rendering YouTube videos with thumbnail preview and embedded player, including utility functions for handling YouTube URLs and time.

classes.name: YoutubeVideo
classes.description: React component for displaying and playing YouTube videos with thumbnail support.

methods.name: getDerivedStateFromProps
methods.description: Updates component state based on new props, managing thumbnail resolution and playback state.

methods.name: getMaxResUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for maximum resolution thumbnail based on video link.

methods.name: getHQUrl
methods.description: Constructs URL for high quality thumbnail based on video link.

methods.name: handleImageError
methods.description: Handles thumbnail image load errors, falling back to lower resolution.

methods.name: play
methods.description: Sets state to start video playback.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Sets state to stop video playback.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI, including thumbnail or embedded video player.

methods.name: isYoutubeLink
methods.description: Static method to check if a link is a YouTube URL.
